dsh-moa.actions.saved_memory_only: Saved to session memory only (not persisted to disk)
dsh-moa.aggregator.arena_desc: Anonymizes candidate models as Option A/B/C for blind human voting with local ELO leaderboard ranking.
dsh-moa.aggregator.arena_title: ⚔️ Blind Battle Arena & Human Jury Mode
dsh-moa.aggregator.ast_heatmap_desc: Visualizes line-by-line consensus agreement across models with interactive contested block resolution.
dsh-moa.aggregator.ast_heatmap_title: 🌈 AST Consensus Heatmap in Code Diff
dsh-moa.aggregator.benchmark_desc: Calibrates ensemble accuracy, latency, and cost against ground-truth coding puzzles vs single baseline.
dsh-moa.aggregator.budget_desc: Cap maximum run cost; auto-trim candidate pool or abort to prevent accidental token spend.
dsh-moa.aggregator.composite_desc: Synthesize modular code blocks, types, and algorithms from multiple candidates into a unified composite.
dsh-moa.aggregator.context_pruning_desc: Replaces unchanged base project files with compact unified diffs (---/+++ hunks) in the Judge prompt, slashing prompt tokens by up to 85%.
dsh-moa.aggregator.council_arbitration_desc: Replaces single-judge bias with a 3-expert jury: Systems Architect, Security Auditor, and Pragmatic Minimalist.
dsh-moa.aggregator.cove_gate_desc: Formulates API existence & method signature verification questions, disqualifying candidates that use hallucinated methods.
dsh-moa.aggregator.early_consensus_desc: Bypass the expensive judge round when reference models converge on equivalent code solutions.
dsh-moa.aggregator.ecosystem_desc: Enriches candidate generation with AST symbol graphs and architectural invariants (graceful autonomous fallback).
dsh-moa.aggregator.ecosystem_title: 🌐 Context Lens & LLM Wiki Ecosystem Injection
dsh-moa.aggregator.embedding_clustering_desc: Bypass LLM Judge when candidate embeddings converge into a dominant cluster (>= threshold).
dsh-moa.aggregator.escalation_desc: Detects divergence across candidates. When consensus is weak, automatically upgrades to a senior flagship judge or convenes a 3-judge panel.
dsh-moa.aggregator.escalation_policy_upgrade: Auto-Upgrade to Senior Judge on Divergence
dsh-moa.aggregator.fallback_to_judge_label: Fallback to Judge if Opinion Splits
dsh-moa.aggregator.git_tournament_desc: Executes candidate proposals in isolated Git worktrees and runs real project tests (npm test, pytest).
dsh-moa.aggregator.hard_budget_desc: Pre-calculates turn costs against a hard financial ceiling, automatically scaling down or halting execution.
dsh-moa.aggregator.hard_budget_title: 🛡️ Hard Token Budget Guard with Auto-Scaling
dsh-moa.aggregator.judge_models_desc: Specify 2 or more judge models for panel consensus.
dsh-moa.aggregator.judge_models_empty: At least 2 judge models are required for consensus voting.
dsh-moa.aggregator.knowledge_desc: Persists consensus decisions to ~/.dsh/moa/knowledge.json and syncs with dsh-memory-brain to prevent recurring debates.
dsh-moa.aggregator.local_fallback_desc: Automatically fall back to local Ollama / MiniPC models when online candidate APIs fail.
dsh-moa.aggregator.local_models_desc: Local offline models used when cloud candidate APIs fail.
dsh-moa.aggregator.local_models_empty: Configure at least one local fallback model (e.g. Ollama).
dsh-moa.aggregator.mixer_desc: Enables discrete AST/markdown block extraction and manual composition across candidates with judge reconciliation.
dsh-moa.aggregator.multi_judge_desc: Deploy multiple judge models to score candidates and determine winner via consensus voting.
dsh-moa.aggregator.multi_stream_desc: Streams parallel candidate tokens in real-time split columns with TTFT and tok/s speed metrics.
dsh-moa.aggregator.multi_turn_desc: Retain conversation context across turns while pruning duplicate code blocks.
dsh-moa.aggregator.mutation_gate_desc: Injects synthetic faults into candidate code to test test-suite robustness, eliminating tautological and weak tests.
dsh-moa.aggregator.mutation_gate_title: 🧬 Runtime Mutation Testing Gate for Candidate Tests
dsh-moa.aggregator.pareto_slider_desc: Reactive balance from 100% free local edge models to ultra-rigorous flagship multi-judge consensus.
dsh-moa.aggregator.pareto_slider_title: 📈 Cost vs Quality Pareto Frontier Slider
dsh-moa.aggregator.pr_review_desc: Autonomous multi-model code review for Gitea/GitHub pull requests with de-duplicated blocker detection.
dsh-moa.aggregator.pr_review_title: 🤖 PR & Webhook Consensus Reviewer Bot Mode
dsh-moa.aggregator.preferences_desc: Injects learned developer preferences (strict typing, functional immutability, error boundaries) to guide Judge synthesis.
dsh-moa.aggregator.preflight_syntax_desc: Validate candidate code syntax locally before judge invocation to filter broken code without token costs.
dsh-moa.aggregator.privacy_gate_desc: Scans and redacts proprietary secrets, local paths, and private network IPs before forwarding proposals to external cloud judges.
dsh-moa.aggregator.privacy_gate_title: 🛡️ Hybrid Private Edge MoA (Local Edge Proposers + Cloud Judge)
dsh-moa.aggregator.profiler_gate_desc: Runs isolated micro-benchmarks measuring execution latency, throughput (ops/sec), and heap memory usage.
dsh-moa.aggregator.profiler_gate_title: ⚡ Automated Runtime Memory & CPU Profiler Gate
dsh-moa.aggregator.rebuttal_debate_desc: Candidates cross-examine peer solutions and expose flaws before judge arbitration.
dsh-moa.aggregator.report_desc: Generate downloadable Markdown & JSON reports detailing candidate latency, agreement, test gate, and cost breakdown.
dsh-moa.aggregator.security_gate_desc: Red-team security auditor checks candidate proposals for SQLi, XSS, ReDoS, Command Injection and Path Traversal with blocking SECURITY_VETO.
dsh-moa.aggregator.self_consistency_desc: Expands a single reference model into multiple parallel samples with varied temperatures and personas, bringing MoA benefits to single-model setups.
dsh-moa.aggregator.semantic_cache_desc: Persists intermediate candidate outputs locally by deterministic SHA-256 fingerprint, eliminating duplicate API costs on retry or repeat requests.
dsh-moa.aggregator.speculative_gate_desc: Lightweight local edge model generates high-speed token drafts verified and completed in one fast pass by the cloud model.
dsh-moa.aggregator.speculative_gate_title: ⚡ Heterogeneous Speculative Decoding (Local Draft + Cloud Verifier)
dsh-moa.aggregator.stack_personas_desc: Scans project manifests (package.json, Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml, go.mod) and assigns specialized engineering roles to candidate slots.
dsh-moa.aggregator.timeline_desc: Captures granular phase snapshots across debate and synthesis stages with interactive rewind and branch forking.
dsh-moa.aggregator.workbench_companion_note: safe shadow Git checkpoints before file promotion
dsh-moa.aggregator.workbench_desc: Judge scores each candidate file from 1 to 10 with pros/cons. Select desired files across candidates; top model harmonizes and glues them, followed by final judge audit.
dsh-moa.aggregator.workbench_title: 🛠️ Interactive Workbench (1-10 File Scoring & Top-Model Glue)
dsh-moa.config.smart_routing_desc: Analyze task complexity and automatically select the optimal preset.
dsh-moa.early_exit_consensus_tip: Skip judge when candidates reach semantic consensus
dsh-moa.error_boundary.title: ⚠️ MoA UI Error:
dsh-moa.local_preflight_check_tip: Filter syntactically invalid code before judge
dsh-moa.workbench.desc: Inspect candidate file quality scores (1–10), mix and match files across proposals, harmonize with top-model glue, and run a final judge audit.
dsh-moa.workbench.empty_files: No candidate files found for this run.
dsh-moa.workbench.instructions_placeholder: e.g. Ensure all imports match, unify TypeScript types, align function signatures...
dsh-moa.workbench.no_runs: No MoA runs with file candidates recorded yet.
dsh-moa.workbench.promoted_ok: ✅ Harmonized deliverable promoted to workspace root!
dsh-moa.workbench.title: 🛠️ Interactive Synthesis Workbench
